summary: John's 2nd great-grandmother; English-born, immigrated c.1870–72 with Welsh-born father Edward F. Jones.
bio: Anna C. Jones was born Mar 1865 in England and immigrated about 1870–72 (FS GZQT-T86). Her parents were Edward F. Jones (b. c.1840 Wales) and Margaret McIver (b. c.1845 England), in Plymouth in 1880. She married James McGuire and was mother of 11+ children including Francis J. (1898). Her brother Joseph S. Jones married Agnes M. McAvoy, sister of her daughter-in-law Elizabeth. She died 2 Jan 1925 in Larksville.
